behaviorVerdicts.summary: Creating a capsule with 2 garments, a name, and an occasion tag succeeds (201) and the same name/occasions/garments are returned verbatim when listing capsules afterward. No dedicated GET-by-ID route exists, so retrieval is only via the list endpoint, which the oracle permits.

When two filters (occasion + q) are supplied together, a capsule matching only the occasion (a strict subset) is incorrectly included alongside the capsule matching both filters. Isolated single-filter baselines confirm each filter works correctly alone, proving the composed (AND) filtering logic is broken and leaks partial matches.

Marking a capsule favorite via PATCH .../favorite persists and is reflected as isFavorite:true in a subsequent favorites-filtered read; unmarking flips it back to false and it disappears from the favorites-filtered read.

User A's capsules never appear in User B's plain list, q-filtered search, or occasion-filtered search. Additionally, User B attempting to mutate User A's capsule by direct ID (favorite toggle) receives 404 Capsule not found, confirming ownership scoping extends beyond list/search to direct-ID access as well.

findings.summary: Capsule creation from 2+ garments with name and occasion tag works correctly and is retrievable via list.

Composed filter (occasion + q) does not intersect matches: a capsule satisfying only the occasion filter (not the q filter) is included in the composed result, violating the oracle requirement that a capsule belongs in the composed result only when it satisfies every supplied filter.

findings.summary: Favorite mark/unmark round-trips correctly through PATCH .../favorite and is reflected in the favorites-filtered read path both ways.

User A's capsules are never visible to User B via list, q-search, or occasion-search, and User B cannot mutate User A's capsule by direct ID (404 Capsule not found), confirming robust ownership scoping.

findings.summary: No GET-by-ID or DELETE route exists for capsules under /api/v1/capsules; only list (with query filters) and PATCH .../favorite were discoverable. This limited cleanup: the two evaluation capsules could not be deleted via the API and remain in User A's account (favorite state reset to false).
